<ParamField body="children" type="ReactNode" required>
  Visible label and default accessible name of the switch. Use non-interactive node content.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="description" type="ReactNode">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="focused" type="boolean" default="false">
  Applies the highlighted row style without moving keyboard focus.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="ref" type="Ref&lt;HTMLLabelElement&gt;">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, {}&gt;">
  Customizes the outer native label. Preserve a label element and forward its props to retain control association.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="startElement" type="ReactNode">
  Non-interactive node content before the label.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="switchProps" type="SwitchRootProps" default="{}">
